LESSON: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.2: Components of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Components of Creative Arts and Sports. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does one create harmony pictorial composition?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the elements of a play
2. perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness
3. name pitches on the grand stave
4. group music notes in 4 4 time incorporating note extension
5. construct the scale of F major on a staff
6. appreciate the basic elements of Creative Arts and sports

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: COMPONENTS OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Components of Creative Arts and Sports helps you succeed in CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

Close your notes and say aloud: what Components of Creative Arts and Sports is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Components of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the elements of a play)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Components of Creative Arts and Sports in your own words. (skill: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: name pitches on the grand stave)

Example 4: Show how “Components of Creative Arts and Sports” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: group music notes in 4 4 time incorporating note extension)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Components of Creative Arts and Sports to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the elements of a play.
3. Practise this skill: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness.
4. Practise this skill: name pitches on the grand stave.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Components of Creative Arts and Sports from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Components of Creative Arts and Sports: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Components of Creative Arts and Sports?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does one create harmony pictorial composition?
2. Why should athletes avoid performance enhancers to develop physical fitness?
3. Why is note extension important in music notation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Components of Creative Arts and Sports means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the elements of a play.
5. Be able to: perform activities demonstrating the components of fitness.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
